title: fresh&optimize
description: A better minecraft animation pack.It's also has optimize mod.
body:
# fresh-and-optimize
This mod pack optimize games.It's also has animation mod,punchy. Built-in ETF and EMF, you can install special resource packs, a minimap to view your tracks, and a built-in server to play. The client frame rate easily rises to 500fps, the CIT can install opfine resources, and the whole mod package is only for one thing - frame rate optimization.
